steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack logs fast --tail 3` in isolated MLX_STACK_HOME
steps.expected: Last 3 lines from fast.log are shown
steps.observed: Output was FAST-LINE-06, FAST-LINE-07, FAST-LINE-08 (3 lines)
Output showed all 8 existing lines (under default 50-line limit)
`--tail INTEGER  Show last N lines (default 50).` present

steps.action: Start `uv run mlx-stack logs fast --follow --tail 1` and append new lines to fast.log from another process
steps.expected: Appended lines appear in follow output within 1-2s
steps.observed: FOLLOW-TIMING-1 and FOLLOW-TIMING-2 were observed with ~0.10s latency each

steps.expected: Process exits cleanly with no traceback
Only standard service log output is shown
steps.observed: Output contained STANDARD-LINE-04 and STANDARD-LINE-05 only

steps.expected: Clear invalid-service error message and non-zero exit
steps.observed: Error shown: No log file found for service 'bad'... ; exit code 1

assertions.title: List available logs when no service specified

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack logs` with no args
steps.expected: List/table of log files with size and modified time
steps.observed: Rich table displayed Name, Size, Modified columns for fast.log, longctx.log, standard.log

steps.action: Set `log-max-size-mb=1` and create oversized fast/standard logs, then run `uv run mlx-stack logs --rotate`
steps.expected: Eligible logs rotate with informative output
steps.observed: Output: fast rotated, standard rotated, longctx no rotation needed

steps.action: Rewrite oversized fast.log and run `uv run mlx-stack logs --rotate --service fast`
steps.expected: Only fast log rotates with informative output

steps.action: Inspect log directory and gzip archives
steps.expected: New .gz archives exist for rotated logs
steps.observed: fast.log.1.gz, fast.log.2.gz, standard.log.1.gz present and readable

steps.action: After creating two fast archives and current content, run `uv run mlx-stack logs fast --all`
steps.expected: Output includes decompressed archives + current log in chronological order
steps.observed: Output sections included fast.log.2.gz (older), fast.log.1.gz (newer), then current fast.log with expected markers
`logs` listed as “View and manage service logs.”
All required flags are present in help output

frictions.description: Initial shell-background follow test hung when trying to interrupt `uv run mlx-stack logs --follow` with SIGINT in one command, causing a command timeout.
frictions.resolution: Re-ran follow validation via a controlled Python subprocess that appended log lines, captured output timing, and sent SIGINT directly to the process.

summary: Tested 7 assertions for logs command: 7 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked.
